+def _get_units_from_attrs(var) -> str:
+    """Extracts and formats the units/unit attribute (if any) of a variable,
+    for use in one-line variable summaries (e.g. for ``Dataset.__repr__``).
+    """
+    attrs = getattr(var, "attrs", {})
+    units = attrs.get("units") or attrs.get("unit")
+    return f", in {units}" if units else ""
